description: For too long, our foreign policy has been driven by bloated defense budgets and interventionist impulses. Trump has demolished U.S. standing abroad by alienating our closest allies, withdrawing the U.S. from critical international bodies and agreements, destroying USAID (and thus causing a huge number of deaths and spread of disease), and an impulsive return to forever wars that are destabilizing the world, killing civilians, and driving prices up for working people. To protect innocent lives and prevent ruinous economic consequences, America urgently needs to become a force for peace and democracy in the world again.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Scott Wiener for Congress
title: Foreign Policy
